Translation of the telegrams appearing on the China Times of 15th
January 1916.

C: I. D:
I. O. REG
No. 124
Date 26. 2. 16

Special telegram from Pekin.
--------------------------
(1)
The Government in requesting Japan to recognize the Monarchy, has drawn an
agreement and a note has been sent to the Japanese Minister by the Cabinet-
secretary and the Minister of Foreign Affairs. Upon the approval of the
Japanese Government, the signing of the agreement is to be formally made.
The articles of the Agreement are as follows.

1. Kirin province to be acceded ' to Japan.
2. The Executive power of Mukden to be acceded to Japan.
3. The Northern Section of the Tientsin Pukow Railway to be acceded to
Japan.
4. The Sea-routes bordering the sea-coast of Tientsin and Shantung to be
acceded to Japan.
5. Chinese Government to engage Japanese financial advisers.
6. The instruction of the Chinese army shall be undertaken by Japanese.
7. The joint-administration of Chinese Arsenals by Japanese.

------------------------------------
(2)
Major Chang Ching Yao of the 7th Division of Nanwei infantry stationed in Pe-
-kin, an ardent subordinate of Minister Tuan, has recently shown dissatis-
faction on the monarchial question. On his transfer to the South, he gave
taels fifty to each of his soldiers as gratuity to the soldiers' families
and decided to go only as far as Sing Yang chow. On arrival at Sing Yang chow
the train did not stop. The whole regiment bolted and half of them dispersed.
The news terrified Pekin.    22nd Jan, 1916.  Pekin Telegram.
------------------------------------
(3)
************* This is a thing to be much regretted. We can not but give a
just verdict viz: " Deserved to be killed."

23rd January, 1916.   Leading Article.

1916年1月15日《字林西报》所载电文的译文。

C: I. D:
I. O. REG
第124号
日期 16. 2. 26.

来自北京的特急电报。
--------------------------
(1)
政府在请求日本承认君主制时，拟定了一项协定，并由内阁秘书与外交总长向日本公使递交了一份照会。待日本政府批准后，将正式签署该协定。协定条款如下：

1. 吉林省割让给日本。
2. 奉天（沈阳）的行政权割让给日本。
3. 津浦铁路北段割让给日本。
4. 毗邻天津及山东海岸的海上航线割让给日本。
5. 中国政府聘请日本财政顾问。
6. 中国军队的训练由日本人承担。
7. 中日共同管理中国的兵工厂。

------------------------------------
(2)
驻扎在北京的南威（音译）步兵第七师少校张敬尧（Chang Ching Yao），是段祺瑞总长的狂热下属，近期在君主制问题上表现出不满。在其调往南方之际，他发给每名士兵五十两白银，作为对其家属的赏赐，并决定仅行至信阳州（Sing Yang chow）。抵达信阳州时，列车并未停靠。全团士兵哗变，其中半数溃散。此消息令北京方面感到惊恐。    1916年1月22日。北京电报。
------------------------------------
(3)
************* 此事令人深感遗憾。我们不得不作出公正的裁决，即：“死有余辜。”

1916年1月23日。社论。
